items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I used to hit on all of them, and she'd say, 'Leave me alone. You're not my type of man.'

ctx.x: Yeah. She had this little daughter. I used to hit on all of them, and she'd say, 'Leave me alone. You're not my type of man.' 'I like you.' Hit on her (?). 'Why don't you leave me alone?' I'd annoyed her. She went to Philadelphia, got pregnant, and started making a whole lot of babies. Mmm! Little Doll. She could play.
